item.title: Look inside this former schoolhouse! On 2 1/2 acres in Indiana. $300,000
item.description: Take a look inside this former schoolhouse! It has been renovated and updated nicely. The school was built in 1880. It is located on 2.5 acres in Brownsville, Indiana. The house features wood floors, exposed beams, bead board, large wood burning fireplace, spacious kitchen, large soaking tub and a beautiful front door. There is a one car garage on the property. Two bedrooms, three bathrooms and 1,690 square feet. $300,000 Contact Natalee Brock with Better Homes and Gardens First Realty Group Fro

item.title: Porch goals! Unpainted woodwork! Circa 1908 in North Carolina. $309,000
item.description: Porch goals! That is a big porch! The interior has unpainted woodwork. The house was built in 1908. The house is located in Fremont, North Carolina. The house features a large covered front porch, original wood floors, baseboards, arched architectural detail in foyer, grand staircase, leaded glass, spacious kitchen, claw foot tub and original mantels. There is a detached two car garage on the property. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 3,190 square feet. $309,000 Contact Lea McCallister with Cold

item.title: Beautiful foyer! Really pretty interior details! Over an acre in North Carolina. $259,000
item.description: That sure is a beautiful foyer! Love the formal rooms and the sunroom also. The kitchen could use some work, but this is a great house! The home was built in 1901. It is located on 1.19 acres in Roxboro, North Carolina. The house features a beautiful foyer, original wood floors, crown moulding, paneled wainscoting, baseboards, nice staircase, pretty arched windows, french doors, sunroom, screened in back porch and chair rails. item.title: Pretty floors! Pretty wainscoting! Circa 1920 in Kansas. $249,000
item.description: This house has pretty wood floors and wainscoting! I love a house that has a second staircase in the kitchen! The house was built in 1920. It is located in Salina, Kansas. The house features a large covered front porch, beautiful wood floors, pretty wainscoting, baseboards, pocket doors, bay windows, stained glass and a spacious kitchen. item.title: Possum Hollow School Teacher’s House, C. 1920. Over an acre in Kentucky. $215,000
item.description: The Possum Hollow Independence School was established in 1884. Many years later a house was built for the teacher. This house was built in 1920. It is located on 1.6 acres in Adairville, Kentucky. The house has a bit of DIY things that I would undo, but it has nice details. The house features a covered front porch, original wood floors, baseboards, crown moulding, wainscoting, stone fireplace, claw foot tub and pressed tin ceilings. item.title: Great screened in porch! Sears Kit House! C. 1918 in Louisiana. $199,500
item.description: I love the screened in porch! This is a Sears Craftsman Bungalow. The house was built in 1918. It is located on .43 acre in Minden, Louisiana. The house could use some updating and undoing of previous renovations. The house features a covered front porch, a screened in porch, wood floors, coffered ceiling, built-in bookshelves, pocket doors, french doors, wainscoting, baseboards and vintage tiled bathrooms. item.title: Lake house in Maine! So quaint! Circa 1950. $375,000
item.description: This sure is a quaint looking house! This lakefront house was built in 1950. It is located on .38 acre in Northfield, Maine. The house features a large side patio, wrap around patio, enclosed porch, wood floors, wainscoting, knotty pine, corner cabinet and chair rails. item.title: Tennessee’s most expensive old house listing! Pinewood Farm, 582 acres. $11,995,000
item.description: Welcome to Tennessee’s most expensive old house listing! Pinewood Farm is a legacy property! It was established in 1850. It is located on 582 acres in Nunnelly, Tennessee. This farm has been a successful cattle farm. There are rolling pastures, hardwood forests and ponds. There are two creeks, five ponds, a fruit orchard, main family house and a one bedroom guest cottage. The farm is one hour from Nashville. Five bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,788 square feet. $$11,995,000 From the Zillow listi

item.title: Pretty setting! Circa 1898. Two acres in Maryland. $399,999
item.description: This house has a pretty setting and nice curb appeal. The house was built in 1898. It is located on 2.04 acres in Street, Maryland. The house could use some updating, but it is nice. The house features a covered front porch, nice curb appeal, pretty setting, original wood floors, nice staircase, crown moulding and a spacious kitchen. There is a large basement and a detached garage. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,436 square feet. $399,999 Contact Timothy Hopkins with Streett Hopkins Real Esta

item.title: Fixer Upper Alert! On 2 1/2 acres in Massachusetts. $195,000
item.description: Fixer upper alert! Even though this needs work, it is a decent price for Massachusetts. The house was built sometime in the mid 1800’s. It is located on 2.5 acres in Ewing, Massachusetts. The house features a covered front porch, wide plank wood floors, baseboards and bay windows. The back of the property is on Millers River.
